Messages.Author: beslin igor
Messages.Body:
LackeyCCG presents you the VTES Online World Championship 2019:
Starting on Monday 7th of October 2019 you can engage in 7 weeks of merciless slaughter to crown yourself Champion.

Do you have what it takes to prevail on the world stage of The Eternal Struggle?
Will you prove yourself victorious, or will you crawl back like a beaten stray dog?

Format:
Best 4 games out of 7 possible will be counted. 1 Game played each week.
Ogranized Games:
Each Monday at 9pm CEST (Central Europe), and 7pm PDT (California US)
Selforganized Games:
You can also find yourself players, play whenever you have time, and report the game back to us.
World Final:
Saturday, 30th November 2019. (start time will vary depending on finalists)
Note: Seating and starting player is selected randomly!
Prize Support:
Winner gets the new 25th anniversary Deck and a copy of the infamous limited Berlin pack.
Organizers America:
Karl Schaefer () Lackey name: kschaefer
Mark Jasper () Lackey name: mjvtes
Adam Hulse () Lackey name: Erewego
Organizers Europe:
Igor Beslin () Lackey name: Beslin Igor
Martin Weinmayer () Lackey name: angrynewb

join our Facebook group "VTES LackeyCCG"
and/or download Lackey directly at www.lackeyccg.com/vtes/tutous.html
